description_html:
• (05:00) - Strauss Zelnick discusses his career and leadership as CEO of Take-Two Interactive, the publisher behind Grand Theft Auto, NBA 2K, and other major franchises. He explains Take-Two’s long-term strategy, Rockstar Games’ creative process, the launch of GTA 6, and his views on acquisitions, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and the future of interactive entertainment.
  • (58:21) - Anthropic IPO
  • (01:01:19) - Hemant Taneja, CEO of General Catalyst, discusses Anthropic’s rapid growth and IPO as evidence of AI’s transformative potential and the expanding scale of venture-backed companies. He also explores new approaches to financing compute infrastructure, the changing venture-capital landscape, and AI’s potential to reshape healthcare and biotechnology.
